layers.process: Nkasa Rupara National Park: the 2020/2021–2029/2030 management plan allows night drives only with a guide on routes approved by park management. Check the current route and availability.

layers.authority: Namibian Ministry of Environment, Forestry and Tourism (MEFT)
layers.process: Nkasa Rupara: the 2020/2021–2029/2030 plan describes tourist access through Shisinze on the north-west boundary using heavy-duty four-wheel-drive vehicles, and says access by boat or air is not permitted. It describes another entrance only as a future possibility; confirm the current route and conditions.

layers.authority: Namibian Ministry of Environment, Forestry and Tourism (MEFT)
layers.process: Nkasa Rupara: the 2020/2021–2029/2030 plan sets a maximum of 40 overnight bed spaces in accommodation, excluding campsites, and no limit at that stage on day visitors. It is a management-plan limit, not a promise of available lodging; confirm with the park.
